purpose: Defines the document system of the project: document identifiers, cross-cutting spec placement, and ID numbering, to prevent duplicated content, ID collisions, and unstable placement.
summary: Defines which document kinds exist, how they are identified, placed, and referenced
IDs are assigned by the next-spec-id skill
FNC-001 identifier is PREFIX-NNN with global numbers and per-prefix series
FNC-002 cross-cutting specs are identified and placed outside any single component
FNC-003 new IDs are never chosen manually, only via the skill
Rationale: duplicate numbers cause ambiguous references and merge-time collisions
tasks: Creating new requirement or design documents
Placing documents in the directory structure
